data.description: The energy-based pause finder (pause.rs) was only tested on TTS clips with clean silences. Test it on real-voice long recordings, including a noisy room; consider Silero VAD (models/vad/ already has silero_vad.onnx, but there's no ONNX runtime in the app build).
data.title: Test chunk cutting on real-voice long recordings; consider a VAD
